purpose: Read-only presentation of one committed native ledger and separately attributed reference differences
identity_checks: Comparison strategy and window match the committed result
A recovered or reopened identity does not append the same dates, orders or trades twice

account_snapshot.money_encoding: Retain native decimal strings; round only for display
account_snapshot.return: equity / manifest.execution.initial_cash - 1, from this same committed snapshot
account_snapshot.final_check: The last committed close equals final_account within the same tolerance
account_snapshot.reference_return: A platform callback returns attribute is not assumed current with its total_value

position_fields.quantity: Native quantity, never the decision target
position_fields.sellable: Native sellable quantity; cash dividends do not create shares
position_fields.price: Native mark with snapshot phase, not an ex-price formula
position_fields.average_price: Native cost basis; a cash-matched alternative need not have the same cost
position_fields.dividend_receivable: Native unpaid entitlement, separate from available cash

actions.policy: result.corporate_action_policy; distinguish source dates from the consumer's model phase
actions.action_cash_flow: Result v1 has no standalone dividend posting table. A balance difference is a derived reconciliation, never an invented native transaction.
actions.tax_deduction: Require explicit native or source evidence. A gross-to-net residual remains labeled as an inference.
actions.share_tradability: For a cash-only action, new share credit and tradability are not applicable; native sellable still follows T+1.

reference_status.same_input_calculation: Report signal and schedule differences separately
reference_status.independent_source: Report observed field coverage; equality to modeled state is not source certification
reference_status.end_to_end: Keep daily cash/equity, quantity, sellable, cost and value differences
reference_status.explained_difference: Attribution does not erase a difference or imply economic equivalence
reference_status.missing_reference: Missing capture is unavailable, never a zero difference
reference_status.overall: No single passed flag may collapse native accounting, conditional research, JQ economic equivalence and UI acceptance

always_visible: The actual source and phase of each dividend or tax figure
write_authority: None: presentation and reconciliation cannot adjust cash, replay orders or replace owner facts
